The FloPlast rigid straight pan connector is an essential component for toilet installations in a variety of bathrooms. Constructed from tough polypropylene, this straight pan connector offers reliability and durability for plumbing professionals. It features a 100mm push-fit inlet and a 110mm push-fit outlet, ensuring secure connections. An integral sealing diaphragm accommodates up to 5° of misalignment, making it ideal for difficult angles, as well as new builds and renovations. This rigid pan connector provides a reliable solution for connecting toilets to drainage systems.
